title: Multi-Profile Management for Chrome and Firefox | VertexStealth
desc: Manage many isolated Chrome and Firefox profiles from one Windows workspace. Per-profile proxies, saved settings, duplicate, backups and fingerprint checks.

howto.name: How to manage multiple browser profiles in VertexStealth
steps: Choose Chrome or Firefox, name the profile and set its proxy and browser settings.
Duplicate a profile to reuse its settings, then change only what differs.
Launch the profiles you need, which appear first in the list, and run Fingerprint Check on each.

faq: Multi-profile management means running several separate browser profiles, each with its own cookies, proxy and settings, and organizing them in one place.
How many profiles can I run at once?
You can launch several profiles at the same time. How many depends on your computer's memory and processor, because each one is a separate browser process.
Can different profiles use different proxies?
Yes. Each profile has its own proxy settings, and you can paste a proxy and test it before launching.
Can I share profiles with teammates?
Not yet. Profiles are stored locally on one computer and are not shared between accounts.
Are my profiles safe when I update the app?
VertexStealth snapshots your profile list the first time each new version starts and keeps recent backups that you can restore from Settings.
Does VertexStealth create or manage accounts on other platforms?
No. It separates browser environments. Whether you may run several accounts on a platform is decided by that platform's terms.
